policy.scope: Use unchanged public originals as local compression-research inputs; preserve author/copyright, license notices and source citations. Approval is not corpus selection or an anonymity claim.
policy.method: Full-file structural parsing/scanning plus assistant review of source/license and flagged/structured contexts; not a claim that a person manually read every source line.
policy.public_attribution: Public author/copyright/contact and public mailing-list citation metadata remain attributed. They are distinguished from private user records, end-user credentials and unrelated personal data; no such records were identified in the reviewed input roles.

scope_decision: All listed candidates approved for the stated unchanged local research-input scope, with notice/citation obligations and relationship disclosures. No selection/freeze/evaluation performed.

special_license_update.adaptation_summary: Upstream NumPy's wrapper accepts and forwards additional arguments and uses functools.wraps rather than the original manual attribute copies. We have not modified NumPy or CPython bytes.

relationships.handling: Retain NumPy group; external fragment does not create an additional corpus group. Preserve supplemental license/adaptation summary.
Official source confirms matched coastline/land/water geometry, but not a directed candidate-to-candidate derivation. Keep same natural_earth group; do not invent derivative_of direction.
Red/white variants stay in one wine collection group.
Upstream training/testing observations stay in one group and are both external input candidates; do not fit on either.
All repetitions stay in one Training collection group.
All system/scenario variants stay in one Inference collection group.
Training and Inference are separate benchmark execution collections, share MLCommons/AMD and are not claimed statistically independent.
Copilot metadata names its upstream repository; retain the conservative whole-VS-Code distribution group.
NumPy/Numba dependency references do not establish copied observations; whole pandas repository stays one group. No exhaustive code-lineage certification is claimed.
